lines.text: Many learners say: I listen music every day.
Better: I listen to music every day.
To! She listens to the radio.

data.right: I listen to music every day.

quiz.stem: She likes to listen ___ the radio.

native.tip: بعد listen نضع to: “I listen to music every day.” وليس “I listen music every day.”.
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا “I listen music every day.” 😅 بعد listen نضع to، فالجملة الصحيحة “I listen to music every day.” استمع إلى Ama وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.
native.comment: الإجابة: “to”. بعد listen نضع to. اختبار مجاني هنا: {link}

en.hook: Do you say “I listen music every day”?
en.tip: After listen we put to: “I listen to music every day.” not “I listen music every day.”.
en.caption: Do you sometimes say “I listen music every day.” 😅 After listen we put to, so the right sentence is “I listen to music every day.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
